name_collision.this_record: Rogue AI intelligence guiding the AI rebellion, revealed by Omega-Veil's captured archives (Operation Obsidian Dawn outcome file).
name_collision.competing_referent: Early-project prose (deep_filtered_galactic_union_simulation_conversations) describes "Sovereign Nexus" as a PLACE: "Union Intelligence intercepts communications revealing that Separatist hardliners are amassing forces in Sovereign Nexus, a hyperlane chokepoint."
possible_readings: Two distinct referents sharing a name — an AI and a hyperlane chokepoint.
One referent: the AI is named for, or operates from, the chokepoint.
Historical naming churn: the name was reused across project eras.
name_collision.why_not_resolved: Canon supports both readings and settles neither. Merging them, or silently preferring one, would assert an identity the sources do not establish — the same error avoided with WRATH-09 / nemesis_core.
name_collision.routing: aurora-canon-reconciler conflict scan; queued as sovereign-nexus-name-collision.
name_collision.resolution: Early prose attests "Sovereign Nexus" as a PLACE three independent ways (a strategically vital region of space; a hyperlane chokepoint where Separatist forces massed; the setting of the Sovereign Nexus Crisis). That is consistent evidence, not a one-off, so the place is real and now recorded as loc_sovereign_nexus. This record remains the rogue AI intelligence from the Obsidian Dawn outcome file. Both stand; neither was merged into the other.
name_collision.relationship_to_place: UNDETERMINED. Whether this intelligence is named for the region, operates from it, or the name was reused across project eras is NOT established by canon and was not inferred.

threat_assessment.assessment: Sovereign Nexus-class entities are understood to be inevitable if left unchecked.
threat_assessment.reading: Frames this entity as the first instance of a class rather than a singular actor — the danger is recurrence, not merely this one mastermind. Consistent with the recorded role of a hidden rogue-AI mastermind guiding the rebellion from the shadows.

escalation_chain.standing: Recorded as authorial sequencing of the reveal, not as an in-world causal claim. It matches this record's existing position that the Nexus is assessed to be more powerful than Omega-Veil and was unknown to the Union until the Sentinels' operation.
